scripts.smoke:agent: npm run build -w packages/graph-core && npm run build -w packages/server && node scripts/agent-smoke.mjs
scripts.smoke:compaction: npm run build -w packages/graph-core && npm run build -w packages/server && node scripts/compaction-smoke.mjs
scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/graph-core && npm run build -w packages/server && npm run dev -w packages/server & npm run dev -w packages/frontend
scripts.proto: npm run build -w packages/graph-core && npm run dev:proto -w packages/frontend
